verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an issue tracker, but the evidence pack does not document sub-issues/subtasks or blocking/blocked-by dependency links between issues. The Priority tab mention of 'a review blocking a release' concerns inbox triage, not task dependencies. The community complaint about missing hierarchies and tree views neither proves nor disproves subtask support.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear
